title: EFC — Subhypothesis: Light Speed Limit
description: Proposes that the universal light-speed limit (c) is an emergent property of underlying energy-flow dynamics, rather than a primary boundary condition. It frames c as meaningful only within regimes where energy gradients sustain space-time, becoming irrelevant at the entropy extremes S=0 (singularity) and S=1 (ultimate dispersion), with maximal dynamical complexity at intermediate entropy.

mass_energy_equivalence.description: Mass–energy equivalence used to emphasize c as a fundamental conversion factor linking mass and energy in relativity.

escape_velocity_light_limit.description: Event horizons are defined where the escape velocity equals the speed of light, marking observational limits in curved space-time.

entropy_domain.description: Normalized entropy parameterization used in the hypothesis: S=0 (singularity), S=1 (ultimate dispersion), with maximal dynamics near intermediate S.

key_results.main_finding: The paper argues that the light-speed limit is an emergent consequence of energy-flow constraints that sustain space-time, losing operational relevance at the entropy extremes S=0 and S=1, with peak dynamical complexity near S≈0.5.

sealed_predictions.statement: In regions approaching the halo boundary (conceptually S > 0.9), observable dynamics and net energy-flow–driven variability will taper asymptotically toward zero.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Time-domain surveys and multiwavelength flux/variability studies showing sustained high-amplitude, broadband variability in environments independently identified as extreme low-gradient regimes.

sealed_predictions.statement: Measures of complexity/awareness in physical or biological systems will peak at intermediate entropy/energy-flow regimes (near S≈0.5) and diminish toward S→0 and S→1.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Robust, cross-system measurements demonstrating monotonic increase of complexity with entropy or persistence of maximal complexity at very low or very high entropy extremes.

kill_criteria: KC1: Verified superluminal transmission of causal information in vacuum (any reproducible experiment or astrophysical observation demonstrating v > c for signals).

KC2: Observations of sustained, high-amplitude dynamical variability and net energy flow in regions empirically characterized as extreme low-gradient (proxy for S > 0.9), contradicting the predicted halo-boundary tapering.

KC3: Demonstration that fully dynamical space-time behavior (e.g., persistent curvature evolution, wave propagation) occurs in an environment with rigorously established absence of energy gradients, undermining the claim that energy flow sustains space-time.
KC4: Reliable evidence that system-level complexity or awareness increases monotonically toward either entropy extreme (S→0 or S→1), refuting the predicted intermediate (S≈0.5) peak.
